factorMeaning: ARM64 execution seconds divided by the corresponding x86_64 execution seconds. Values below 1 make ARM64 faster; values above 1 make ARM64 slower. Startup overhead is never scaled.
derivation: Methodology-only synthetic assumptions frozen before the Phase 4 experiment. Each base task-class factor is multiplied by a deterministic FNV-1a-derived jitter in [1-jitterFraction, 1+jitterFraction]. These values are not measurements and must not be interpreted as AWS Graviton benchmarks.

vidpro-task-class-mixed-v1.description: Synthetic mixed architecture sensitivity: validation and merge favor ARM64, while video segment cutting favors x86_64. A two-percent deterministic per-task/per-mode jitter prevents an unsupported constant architecture ratio.

neutral-equal-performance-v1.description: Neutral control in which corresponding ARM64 and x86_64 modes have exactly equal execution and startup times.
